data.title: Building enquiry for garden house rejected
data.summary: The City of Beispielheim building authority (Baurechtsamt) rejected your preliminary building enquiry of 12 January 2026 for a garden house. The letter is dated 2 March 2026 and allows an objection within one month of notification.
data.explanation: The city has refused your request to build a 42 m³ garden house in the outdoor area (Außenbereich), because it would harm public interests under § 35 (2) BauGB. You may decide whether to file an objection (Widerspruch), in writing or recorded in person at the city, or with the responsible objection authority. The app shows the deadline. If you do nothing, the decision becomes final. A separate fee notice (Gebührenbescheid) will follow. Consider professional advice if you want to challenge the decision.

items.title: File objection against rejection

date.text: Frist: ein Monat ab Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids.

items.action: If you want to contest the rejection, file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or recorded in person at the City of Beispielheim, or with the responsible objection authority.
items.consequence: Without an objection in time, the rejection becomes final.
items.quote: Rechtsbehelf: Widerspruch. Frist: ein Monat ab Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids.

key_facts.label: Enquiry date (Bauvoranfrage vom)
key_facts.quote: Ihre Bauvoranfrage vom 12.01.2026 zur Errichtung eines Gartenhauses mit 42 m³

key_facts.label: Legal basis of rejection
key_facts.quote: Das Vorhaben ist nach § 35 Abs. 2 BauGB nicht zulässig, da es öffentliche Belange beeinträchtigt.

key_facts.label: Fee
key_facts.quote: Für diese Entscheidung wird eine Gebühr festgesetzt; hierzu erhalten Sie einen gesonderten Gebührenbescheid.
